svg.title: Doc 63 — food and alchemy station artwork
svg.desc: All eight native station and habitat sprite state sets at four-times scale, native-size insets and seven independently drawn inventory icons. Working animations contain four frames at five frames per second. Only new bespoke artwork is embedded.

g.text: Food and alchemy station review — all state frames · 4-frame loops at 5 fps
Inventory icons — independently drawn, 8× and native 1×
